common_confusions: BC-MIS-08003 (a calculator value treated as standing on its own)
BC-MIS-08009 (a reported result treated as complete once the number is named)
diagnostic_archetypes: BC-QA-08001 (the integrand has no elementary antiderivative, so the written setup is the only evidence of method)
adaptive.mastered_if: The page carries the integral expression with its limits and its differential, visible evidence of the division by the interval length, and a value reported to three places after the decimal point; stored values rather than truncated decimals feed the final computation, so neither BC-ERR-08004 nor BC-ERR-99019 is present.
adaptive.partially_mastered_if: A correct decimal appears alone with no integral and no quotient written down, which is BC-ERR-08004; or the setup is complete and an intermediate decimal is truncated to two or three places before the last step, moving the reported value, which is BC-ERR-99019.
adaptive.prerequisite_gap_if: The answer is correct but given to one place, or rounded rather than truncated against the convention, which is a reporting gap at BC-PRQ-08006 rather than a failure of the average value setup itself.
adaptive.remediation_target: BC-MIS-08003 (that the written expression, not the calculator display, is the mathematical claim) for the conceptual case; BC-PRQ-08006 (three place reporting and storing unrounded intermediates) for the procedural case.

common_confusions: BC-MIS-08003 (a calculator value treated as standing on its own)
BC-MIS-08009 (a result treated as complete once the number is named)
diagnostic_archetypes: BC-QA-08004 (an applied amount must be both evaluated and reported in context)
adaptive.mastered_if: The integral is evaluated by an antiderivative or with technology and the number is reported in the context with the units of the accumulated quantity, to three places after the decimal point when technology is used; unrounded intermediates feed the final step, so neither BC-ERR-99019 nor BC-ERR-08007 appears.
adaptive.partially_mastered_if: The evaluation is correct and the number is reported bare, without the units of the accumulated quantity, which is BC-ERR-08007; or an intermediate decimal is truncated before the last computation and the reported value moves in the third place, which is BC-ERR-99019.
adaptive.prerequisite_gap_if: The reported value carries the wrong number of decimal places or is rounded against the stated convention, which is BC-PRQ-08006 rather than an evaluation gap.
adaptive.remediation_target: BC-MIS-08009 (what a reported accumulation must state) for the conceptual case; BC-PRQ-08006 (storing intermediates and reporting to three places) for the procedural case.

common_confusions: BC-MIS-08012 (limits treated as a viewing window rather than the boundary of the region)
BC-MIS-08003 (a calculator value treated as standing on its own)
diagnostic_archetypes: BC-QA-08008 (the crossings are not exact values, so storing them is what protects the third decimal place)
adaptive.mastered_if: The equation of the two curves is solved with technology on the stated domain, the solutions are stored rather than transcribed as short decimals, and the stored values are used as the limits of the area integral; the reported area agrees to three places with a recomputation from the stored limits, and neither BC-ERR-99019 nor BC-ERR-08019 appears.
adaptive.partially_mastered_if: The crossings are located correctly and then written and reused as two or three place decimals, so the reported area differs in the third decimal place, which is BC-ERR-99019 and exactly the observation in BC-SIG-08008; or the solver is run over a window that returns a crossing outside the region, which is BC-ERR-08019.
adaptive.prerequisite_gap_if: The stored value is reported rounded to the wrong number of places or rounded rather than truncated, which is BC-PRQ-08006 rather than a solving gap.
adaptive.remediation_target: BC-MIS-08012 (which inputs bound the region) for the conceptual case; BC-PRQ-08006 (storing unrounded solutions before reusing them) for the procedural case.

common_confusions: BC-MIS-08017 (the difference of squares equated to the square of the difference)
BC-MIS-08023 (the upper curve assumed to give the outer radius)
diagnostic_archetypes: BC-QA-08011 (the integrand is a squared difference, so the cross term is the scored detail)
adaptive.mastered_if: The volume integral is evaluated by expanding the squared difference into three terms and antidifferentiating each, or numerically with the unexpanded integrand stored, and the value is reported to the required accuracy; the cross term survives the expansion and no intermediate is truncated, so neither BC-ERR-08030 nor BC-ERR-99019 appears.
adaptive.partially_mastered_if: The setup is correct and the expansion drops the cross term, squaring each part of the difference separately, which is BC-ERR-08030; or the integration is right and a stored decimal is truncated before the last step, which is BC-ERR-99019.
adaptive.prerequisite_gap_if: The antidifferentiation fails on a term with a negative or fractional exponent produced by the expansion, which is BC-PRQ-06002 rather than a volume gap.
adaptive.remediation_target: BC-MIS-08017 (that squaring does not distribute over subtraction) for the conceptual case; BC-PRQ-06002 (antidifferentiating the expanded terms) for the procedural case.

common_confusions: BC-MIS-08020 (a volume of revolution integrating the radius rather than its square)
BC-MIS-08003 (a calculator value treated as standing on its own)
diagnostic_archetypes: BC-QA-08012 (a numerical volume is requested, so the constant factor shows in the reported value)
adaptive.mastered_if: The disc integral is evaluated by antidifferentiating the squared radius or with technology, and the reported volume retains the factor pi, either as an exact multiple of pi or as a decimal that includes it; unrounded intermediates feed the final step, so neither BC-ERR-08037 nor BC-ERR-99019 appears.
adaptive.partially_mastered_if: The integral of the square of the radius is evaluated correctly and the answer is reported without pi, which is BC-ERR-08037, the integrand without its constant factor being BC-SIG-08013; or pi is retained and a truncated intermediate moves the value, which is BC-ERR-99019.
adaptive.prerequisite_gap_if: The antiderivative of the squared radius is wrong because of exponent handling, which is BC-PRQ-06002 rather than a reporting gap.
adaptive.remediation_target: BC-MIS-08020 (where pi and the square come from) for the conceptual case; BC-PRQ-06002 (antidifferentiating the squared radius) for the procedural case.

common_confusions: BC-MIS-08003 (a calculator value treated as standing on its own)
BC-MIS-08024 (every definite integral read as an area)
diagnostic_archetypes: BC-QA-08014 (the integrand has no elementary antiderivative, so the written expression is the only record of method)
adaptive.mastered_if: The arc length integral is written on the page with its radical integrand and limits, evaluated numerically, and reported to three places after the decimal point from unrounded stored values; neither BC-ERR-08045 nor BC-ERR-99019 appears.
adaptive.partially_mastered_if: A correct decimal length appears with no integral expression anywhere, which is BC-ERR-08045; or the setup is shown and a truncated intermediate derivative or bound is reused, moving the third decimal place, which is BC-ERR-99019.
adaptive.prerequisite_gap_if: The value is right but rounded to the wrong number of places or rounded against the stated convention, which is BC-PRQ-08006 rather than an evaluation gap.
adaptive.remediation_target: BC-MIS-08003 (the written integral as the scored object) for the conceptual case; BC-PRQ-08006 (three place reporting from stored values) for the procedural case.
